title: Harrington tours the Greenbrier bunker

tellings.quote: was later when I was secretary of energy. I got to see that cuz we were down at Greenbryer. I think it was Greenbryer playing golf and I went and toured that thing.

plain: John S. Herrington, a former US Secretary of Energy, says that while in that job in the mid 1980s he toured the secret government bunker at the Greenbrier, a resort in West Virginia. He says he was there playing golf and went to see it. He tells it firsthand, as one of the hidden government places he saw from inside.
